Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer, Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This role focuses on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or conventional project management. As the technical lead in multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help deliver safe, feasible and maintainable solutions within a controlled project environment.

You operate in an operational brownfield setting where safety, reliability, technical quality and limited disruption to production are essential. The position combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad view of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

• Establish and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Lead and align engineering work across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close cooperation with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
• Organise design reviews and assess solutions for safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Convert process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts, and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Evaluate technical alternatives with regard to feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Give technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and critically review their content, quality, planning and deliverable completeness.
• Support technical decision-making, record assumptions and deviations, and ensure that decisions and follow-up actions remain traceable.
• Identify technical and project risks, assessing how changes may affect scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and contractual technical clarifications.
• Follow up Mechanical & Piping activities where relevant, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Support the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent stakeholder reporting.
• Coach engineers and contribute to project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process consists of two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview that includes a business case.

• You have a master's degree in a technical discipline, or an equivalent level gained through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You bring extensive experience in technical design and engineering within an industrial or process environment.
• You have demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering in the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You can provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically assess their deliverables.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before the start.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an asset.
• You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You communicate complex technical topics clearly and work effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented manner, with a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms. 

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration. 

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios. 

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place. 

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues. 

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent. 

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

As an Operator, you operate computer-controlled production machines, keeping the process efficient and high-quality. You set machine parameters, perform quality checks, and make sure the final product is packaged correctly.
A typical day? Setting up machines, following up on planning, and performing quality controls. You work together with colleagues to achieve the best results.
Do you see yourself in this role? Apply now and strengthen the team as an Operator!

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Teamleader - 2 shifts - long term - Evergem
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Team Leader with a passion for logistics operations and people management? Do you enjoy motivating teams and ensuring smooth warehouse processes? Then this opportunity in Evergem could be the next step in your career.

Our client is a leading logistics company operating from a modern, sustainable warehouse facility. To support their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Logistics Team Leader to strengthen their operations team.

To succeed in this role, you combine strong leadership skills with practical logistics experience.

Your Profile

 
• Fluent in Dutch with good communication skills in English
 
• Knowledge of French is a strong advantage
 
• Experience in a warehouse, logistics, or supply chain environment
 
• Previous experience as a Team Leader, Shift Leader, Warehouse Coordinator, or Supervisor
 
• Strong people management and coaching skills
 
• Results-oriented, proactive, and hands-on mindset
 
• Able to work independently while remaining a true team player
 
• Valid Forklift Certificate and/or Reach Truck Certificate
 
• Strong focus on safety, quality, and operational excellence

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections.
 

As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools. 

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues. 

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise. 

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs). 

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance. 

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 
The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 
The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 
 
As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.
